analysis.title: The Day Ahead - North America, Wednesday November 25, 2026
key_insights: Nasdaq fell 1.48% to 23,733.54 and S&P 500 fell 0.50% to 7,201.09 as tech gave back Monday's Nvidia-led rally. The Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70.
Nvidia fell 5.86% after CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement on Monday. Governance critics say the board acted before its investigations concluded, and the AI trade questions are not resolved.
Today's focus is October PCE, the last key data before the Fed's final 2026 meeting. Poll is headline PCE +0.3% MoM and 3.8% YoY, core +0.3% MoM and 3.2% YoY.
Q3 GDP second estimate is forecast at 3.5% annualized in the text, though the event table shows a 3.4% poll. Durable goods are expected +0.6% in the text versus 0.4% in the table.
Treasury yields were little changed with 10-year at 4.9337%, 30-year at 5.3203% and 2-year at 4.6912%. The $70B 5-year auction cleared at 4.719% with bid-to-cover 2.37.
The dollar index fell 0.48% to 103.82. The dollar had been supported by bets the Fed keeps raising rates, but BBH says the US growth edge over the euro zone, UK and Japan narrowed in November.

Brent rose 1.58% to $90.78 and WTI 1.41% to $81.38 after new attacks on vessels near the Strait of Hormuz. Analysts say crude is sensitive to actual delivery disruption given excess supply expectations.
Spot gold fell 2.21% to $3,551.34 on hawkish Fed signals, firm December hike expectations and equity-driven margin liquidation.
Anthropic closed 6.54% lower at $81.91, below its $83 IPO price days after its Nasdaq debut. Risks cited are insider selling from lock-up terms, open-weight model pressure and a data-center slowdown.
HPE fell 16.33% to $40.18 despite a 50% jump in Q4 revenue to $14.55B. FY27 adjusted operating margin guide is 14-15% versus 15.1% in FY26 as AI server costs outrun pricing.
Dollar Tree rose 11.82% after raising FY26 adjusted EPS guidance to $8.05-$8.25 on 4.6% comps. Best Buy raised its comp target to 3.4-4%.
Analog Devices fell 16.47% and Dell fell 11.35% in the S&P 500 losers list.
Sanofi will buy Insmed for $41B cash at $175 per share, a 17.5% premium. GTCR is seeking Blackstone, Warburg Pincus and Apollo backing for its roughly $50B Global Payments take-private.
The Trump administration is set to release an excess industrial capacity probe covering 16 trading partners, with new tariffs expected.
Conference Board consumer confidence rose to 103.3 in November, the highest since January 2025, from 91.9 in October.
Bank of Canada raised to 2.5% last month. Macklem says year-end inflation may come in below the 3.5% forecast as oil and refinery margins fell. The TSX fell 0.35%, with materials down 2.46%.
Jet fuel remains more than 50% above pre-war levels. Singapore spot was about $141 a barrel versus about $93 pre-war, and some airlines are stress-testing $200 jet fuel in 2027.
Microsoft declared a 'Code Red' after a 24-hour Exchange Online outage. Deere reports Q4 before market open with consensus EPS $2.12.

Fell 16.33% to $40.18 on shrinking AI server margins despite a raised FY27 revenue growth outlook of 27-35%.
Fell 16.47% to $316.36 in the S&P 500 losers list. No reason is given in the report.
Fell 11.35% to $296.90. No reason is given in the report.
Rose 11.82% after a Q3 beat and a raised FY26 adjusted EPS forecast to $8.05-$8.25.
Raised comp growth target to 3.4-4% and FY27 adjusted EPS to $6.90-$7.05 on AI-device demand.
Closed at $81.91, below the $83 IPO price, on lock-up selling and data-center slowdown risk.
Reports Q4 before market open. Investors will watch its 2027 net income forecast.
Rose 8.26% to $32.70 in the S&P 500 gainers list. No reason is given in the report.

sector_views.rationale: AI stocks are being repriced after the Monday rally faded, with margin and debt-spending concerns.
Materials fell 2.46% on weaker gold and higher-for-longer Fed expectations.
Canadian energy rose 0.74% on Hormuz shipping risks supporting crude.

earnings_insights: Deere Q4 reports before market open Nov 25. Consensus EPS est $2.12 (LSEG IBES and Smart Estimate), year-ago $3.93, revenue est $10,366.45M.
HPE Q4 revenue reported at $14.55B, up 50%, topping estimates. FY27 revenue growth guide raised to 27-35% from 13-17%. FY27 adjusted operating margin guide 14-15% versus 15.1% in FY26.
Dollar Tree Q3 reported adjusted EPS $1.16 versus est $0.91. Revenue reported $5.08B versus est $5.04B. FY26 adjusted EPS guide raised to $8.05-$8.25 from $7.70-$8.05.
Best Buy Q3 reported revenue $10.24B (+5.8%) versus LSEG est $9.90B. Reported adjusted EPS $1.62 topped estimates. FY27 adjusted EPS guide raised to $6.90-$7.05.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Consensus poll versus 0.5% in September. A hot print supports December hike pricing.
Expected versus 3.1% prior. Inflation stays well above the Fed's 2% target.

macro_indicators.reading: 3.5% annualized in text, 3.4% poll in table
macro_indicators.interpretation: Strong growth supports the Fed hiking narrative.
Expected down 3,000 from 203,000, signaling a tight labor market.
First hike in three years, with further increases possible.

risk_factors: New US tariffs from the excess capacity probe.
AI trade debt-funded spending and return doubts.
Nvidia governance and legal liabilities not resolved.
Hawkish Fed with a December hike priced in.
Hormuz shipping disruption and elevated jet fuel.
Anthropic lock-up selling and data-center slowdown.
vol_and_positioning: Equities saw choppy trading after the AI rally faded, with margin-driven liquidation across asset classes including gold and silver.
The yield curve flattened on Monday during the equity rally, which one CIO read as bonds not pricing growth from AI.
geopolitical: New attacks on vessels near the Strait of Hormuz, including a container ship the Iranian Revolutionary Guards said was on an unauthorised route.
US-Israeli war on Iran began in February and keeps jet fuel elevated.
Trump administration to release findings of an excess industrial capacity probe on 16 trading partners with new tariffs expected.
Russian air strike on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine.
Nvidia CEO reinstatement involves Trump's personal intervention and a blacklisting of Singapore-based Megaspeed by the US government.

tension_points.bull_case: Huang's return removes uncertainty and Monday saw the biggest AI rally in months. Reuters poll strategists see the S&P 500 gaining more than 12% by end-2027.
tension_points.bear_case: Profit taking followed, the bond market was not pricing growth from AI, and 20-30% earnings growth quarters are seen as unlikely to continue. Margins are shrinking at HPE.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Further bad headlines on Huang or a slowdown in data-center buildout would break the bull case.

theme_stances.key_argument: After the rally, investors recognize AI earnings growth of 20-30% is unlikely to continue and the complex is being repriced.
theme_stances.evidence: the AI complex is being repriced

theme_stances.key_argument: Hawkish Fed signals and firm December hike expectations pressured gold and supported the dollar.
theme_stances.evidence: firm expectations of a December rate hike
